verdict.rationale: A recorded end-to-end probe shows `npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development` installing just that one skill into ./.claude/skills/, so the collection's per-skill folder packaging does allow selective installs. However, Superpowers' own documented install paths are all whole-bundle (`/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`, git clone), and selective install depends on a generic external installer rather than a first-party feature. missing for 10: first-party documented per-skill install option in Superpowers' own install docs, selective install through the official marketplace/plugin paths, independent corroboration beyond the single probe
